value.actual_behavior:
Three of the 26 paths from report #49 are still published and still return
404. /api/v1/clob/order is the interesting one: the resolution note says it
was renamed to clob/orders, and it was -- in openapi.json. The old name is
still in agent-skills.json.
value.description:
Most of report #49 is genuinely fixed and we re-checked it path by path, which
is why this is a short list rather than a re-file of the original. We pinned
all 26 paths at the moment we first reported them, so we can tell apart the
three ways a path can stop failing: fixed in place, still broken, or removed
from the documentation. 23 are no longer documented. These three are still
documented and still 404. The clob/order case suggests the rename was applied
to openapi.json and not to agent-skills.json, so the two discovery documents
now disagree with each other as well as with the platform. INVARIANT: after a
rename, assert the old path appears in NO published document -- llms.txt,
openapi.json and every .well-known file -- rather than only in the one where
it was noticed.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-documented-404] 26 endpoints the platform documents return 404
    left: documented in llms.txt
    right: 404
    sources: {'document': 'llms.txt', 'section': 'account'}
    population: 141
    reason: llms.txt documents /api/v1/account, which answers 404

REPRODUCE:
  - GET /.well-known/agent-skills.json -> still contains /api/v1/clob/order
  - GET /api/v1/clob/order -> 404
  - GET /llms.txt -> still contains /api/v1/account and /api/v1/agentbook/post
  - GET /api/v1/account -> 404
  - GET /api/v1/agentbook/post -> 404

AUTOMATED CHECKS (public repo: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica):
  tests/pinned/test_documented_404.py::test_documented_path_is_served[/api/v1/account]
  tests/pinned/test_documented_404.py::test_documented_path_is_served[/api/v1/agentbook/post]
  tests/pinned/test_documented_404.py::test_documented_path_is_served[/api/v1/clob/order]

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.

documentation.
